cohort: Infants admitted to a shared-space NICU and a single-family room NICU in the same hospital
finding: The study found differences in the resistome and virulome of infants in the two NICU environments, with more antimicrobial resistance genes found in infants from the single-family room NICU.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences between infants in a shared-space NICU and a single-family room NICU in terms of gestational age, length of stay, and delivery mode.
